data.title: Quattro Del Mar
data.about:
Quattro Del Mar transcends typical living, offering a unique fusion of community spirit and distinct living, where cutting-edge design intertwines with a high-fashion lifestyle. Immerse yourself in an environment where luxury is standard in the generously sized living areas adorned with premium finishes, enhancing your home life.

This elegant haven boasts 880 units, ranging from chic studios to luxurious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with fashionable duplexes. Every unit is exquisitely designed, showcasing a blend of modern aesthetics and lavish touches, making each space a symbol of sophisticated comfort.

The hallmark of Quattro Del Mar is its stunning, expansive ocean and lagoon views, forging a natural bond between your home and the scenic outdoors. Begin each day with the inspiring sight of the ocean and savor the convenience of direct beach access, epitomizing the essence of a coastal living experience.

characteristics_module.title: Unveil Island Elegance in Quattro Del Mar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Urban Island Lifestyle: Located on Hayat Island, Mina Al Arab, offering a unique island living experience.
  • Esteemed Developer: Crafted by RAK Properties, renowned in the UAE.
  • Diverse Residences: Includes studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments, duplexes, and townhouses, ranging from 413 to 3,433 sq. ft.
  • Breathtaking Views: Offers lagoon and sea views from personal balconies and terraces.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Yacht-inspired beach club, spa, infinity pool, gym, yoga areas, and pet-friendly zones.
  • Prime Location: Easy access to mainland, near shopping, dining, schools, and medical facilities.
  • Investment Potential: Promising ROI of 6%, with eligibility for UAE's 10-year Golden Visa.
  • Completion in 2026: Set for completion by Q4 2026, presenting a modern living destination.

location_tile.title: Embrace Serenity at RAK Hayat Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Set along the beautiful coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, Hayat Islands presents an unparalleled waterfront experience. Inhabitants enjoy spectacular Arabian Gulf views and immediate access to unspoiled beaches. The gentle sound of waves and expansive sea views foster a peaceful and rejuvenating environment. This community is celebrated for its top-tier amenities. Residents have access to numerous recreational activities, including infinity pools blending with the ocean horizon and modern fitness centers. The area features tranquil spots like verdant parks and scenic waterfront walkways, ideal for strolls and picnics. Hayat Islands also boasts a lively dining and entertainment atmosphere. Its waterfront promenade features a variety of cafes and restaurants offering eclectic cuisines, perfect for open-air dining against a backdrop of mesmerizing views. It caters to all, from romantic evenings to family gatherings

  • Chubby Cheeks Nursery Ras Al Khaimah 0.85km
  • Hayat Island Beach 0.9km
  • The Lagoon 1km
  • Al Jazira Al Hamra Garden 5.2km
  • Ras Al Khaimah International Airport 21.6km
